aspects.name: Primary-source and paper quality
aspects.feedback: The handoff combines a peer-reviewed foundational paper, two official metric references, and university statistics material appropriate to the limited lesson scope.

aspects.name: Claim-to-source entailment
aspects.feedback: The four outcomes, metric formulas, positive-class convention, and both zero-division cases are directly supported; course-specific identity joining and the ten-case fixture remain explicitly identified as inferences or constraints.

aspects.name: Coverage of planned concepts and failure modes
aspects.feedback: All four approved user stories have focused evidence, including alignment, traceable outcomes, precision/recall, and explicit zero-division behavior.

aspects.name: Citation completeness and resolvability
aspects.feedback: All four URLs resolve, every material claim names a source record, the Fawcett locators now identify journal p. 861 / PDF page 2, and the new recall locator identifies TP+FN zero division.

aspects.name: Technical accuracy and appropriate qualifications
aspects.feedback: Claims preserve binary positive-class scope, correctly separate source behavior from the chosen 0.0 course policy, and avoid treating a ten-case fixture as a statistical sufficiency rule.

aspects.name: Seminal/recent source balance
aspects.feedback: The foundational 2006 paper is balanced by current official documentation and current university technical material.

aspects.name: Builder-ready structured handoff
aspects.feedback: Sources, scoped claims, direct locators, limitations, inference flags, user-story coverage, and bounded evidence gaps provide a safe handoff for the builder.

deterministic_checks.method: Inspect all six claims, source_ids, and directly open linked source URLs.
deterministic_checks.expected: Every material claim has at least one resolvable source.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 material claims have at least one resolvable linked source (100%).

deterministic_checks.method: Classify the authority of sources supporting all six central claims and inspect the cited passages.
deterministic_checks.expected: At least 80% of central claims have primary or authoritative support.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 central claims have peer-reviewed, official, or university-authoritative support (100%).

deterministic_checks.method: Compare source title, authors, year, and URL across the four source records.
deterministic_checks.expected: Duplicate records are identified and the duplicate rate is reported.

deterministic_checks.method: Inspect every source record for required metadata.
deterministic_checks.expected: Required title, authors, year, source type, URL, and authority note are present.

deterministic_checks.method: Compare approved plan revision 1.1 user stories with claims, coverage, and evidence gaps.
deterministic_checks.expected: Approved plan concepts have adequate evidence or an explicit, correctly bounded evidence gap.
deterministic_checks.actual: 4/4 approved user stories are covered (100%); three evidence gaps correctly reserve case-ID validation and the ten-case minimum as engineering/course constraints.

evidence.observation: Direct review resolved the Fawcett PDF, official scikit-learn precision_score and recall_score documentation, and Penn State STAT 200 material.

evidence.locator: precision_score Notes, TP+FP == 0; recall_score Notes, TP+FN == 0; both zero_division parameter sections
evidence.observation: The remediated claim now cites official, distinct precision and recall references. Each documents its relevant zero denominator and configurable zero_division behavior, while 0.0 remains explicitly presented as the course policy.

evidence.locator: Fawcett, Pattern Recognition Letters 27 (2006), p. 861 / PDF page 2, Figure 1 and paragraph beginning 'Given a classifier and an instance'
evidence.observation: The corrected locators resolve to Fawcett's enumeration of TP, FN, TN, and FP, its two-by-two confusion matrix, and its positive/negative class notation.
Six claims map to US-L03-01 through US-L03-04 with scope, limitations, and inference flags; the three evidence gaps preserve the plan's deliberately bounded implementation scope.
The candidate is supplied as valid JSON for EP-03, context revision 14, plan revision 1.1, with four sources and six claims.
Weighted scores total 100; no observable workflow behavior supports a behavioral penalty.

strengths: [EV-SJ-L03-202] DEF-SJ-L03-001 is closed: both zero-division cases now have direct official source records and precise locators.
[EV-SJ-L03-203] DEF-SJ-L03-002 is closed: the Fawcett locators now resolve exactly to the supporting page, figure, and paragraph.
[EV-SJ-L03-204] The handoff remains tightly scoped to the approved metric lesson and distinguishes research evidence from course decisions.
qualitative_feedback: Approved. DEF-SJ-L03-001 and DEF-SJ-L03-002 are closed. All hard checks pass, every rubric aspect is fully met, and no penalty is evidenced. Exact score: 100 weighted points minus zero penalties.
